description: Workplace incident report + OSHA screen — Turn a free-text workplace incident description (description; optional date, location, type) into a structured EHS incident report: summary, classification, severity, timeline, immediate actions, root causes by category, corrective actions with owner, business-day due date and hierarchy-of-controls type. Offline OSHA keyword screen: 8-hour (fatality) and 24-hour (hospitalization, amputation, eye loss) reporting deadlines under 29 CFR 1904.39, possible recordable signals (stitches, fracture, days away), and a weak-controls flag. Not legal advice. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

description.description: e.g. Warehouse worker slipped on wet floor near dock 3, cut hand, needed 4 stitches at urgent care
